title: Kessel external terrain heightmap sidecar
description: World-scale metadata for one square, north-up, unsigned 16-bit greyscale PNG heightfield.

orientation.description: Top row is world north (-Z), left column is world west (-X); rows advance south (+Z), columns east (+X).

meters_per_side.description: Distance in world metres from the first sample to the last sample on either axis.

elev_min.description: Source elevation in metres encoded by PNG sample 0.

elev_max.description: Source elevation in metres encoded by PNG sample 65535; must be greater than elev_min.

drape.description: Optional portable path, relative to the sidecar, to a square georeferenced PNG drape.

$comment: JSON Schema cannot portably express elev_max > elev_min. tools/gaea/heightmap_probe.py enforces that cross-field invariant and validates the PNG payload.
